title: Exactness of constructed kernel boundary at Tor
statement: For every commutative ring R, modules M,F,N and surjective q:F → N, the constructed boundary has exactness of (Tor₁(q,M),δ_q).

proof.text: Unfold Function.Exact at each Tor class y. The forward implication is [lem-sc-p1-tor-kernel-boundary-construction-exact-left-kernel]. For the reverse implication write y = Tor(q,M)(x) and apply [lem-sc-p1-tor-kernel-boundary-construction-exact-left-range].

proof_origin.note: Assemble the two strict implications of Function.Exact; range implication is proved from naturality, kernel implication remains open.

theorem tor_kernel_boundary_construction_exact_left
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    (F N : ModuleCat.{u} R) (q : F →ₗ[R] N) (hq : Function.Surjective q) :
    Function.Exact (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} R) 1).map
      (ModuleCat.ofHom q)).app M).hom (torKernelBoundary M F N q hq)
